verdict.rationale: Asana markets AI Studio as "powerful no-code automations" and refers to built-in rules and rule actions (including one that creates PagerDuty incidents). Zapier, listed in its app directory, offers code-free automation across tools. The evidence is mostly one-line marketing taglines, though, and nothing first-party shows chaining multiple steps, conditions or branching in a no-code builder. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step or conditional rule building, depth on how the AI Studio builder works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of non-technical users building automations.
